info.title: Service bookings API
info.description: Generated from the application. Contract and rules: docs/service-bookings.md

get.summary: The bookable times of a service
get.description: Public. Give `date` (one day) or `from` and `to` (up to 31 days), as calendar dates in the service's own time zone (`time_zone` in the answer). Each slot has `starts_at` / `ends_at` as ISO-8601 with the service's UTC offset: send `starts_at` back unchanged to book it. A slot says how many seats are left and, when it cannot be booked, why (`full`, `provider_busy`, `too_soon`, `too_far`). Slots already count the bookings that hold a place (pending, confirmed, in progress, cancellation requested; an unpaid booking only until its hold ends) and the provider's other bookings. `timezone` (optional, IANA) adds `starts_at_display` in that zone. `provider_id` and `delivery_mode` only check that the service offers them.

get.summary: A service's booking settings, with the meeting link (staff)
get.description: Enterprise Admin of the owning tenant, the service's Provider, or a Super Admin. Everything the service form sets for booking, including the meeting link and passcode that the public catalog never shows.

post.description: A customer books for themselves; the Enterprise Admin can book for a customer (send `customer_name` or `customer_user_id`; `paid: true` confirms a paid booking at once). Free service: confirmed straight away, or `pending` when the service requires approval. Paid service: `pending` with `payment_status: unpaid` and the slot held for the hold time (`hold_expires_at`); it is confirmed once paid (and approved, if required). Send an `Idempotency-Key` header: repeating the request with the same key returns the first booking (200) instead of booking twice. Errors (`detail.code`): SLOT_FULL, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, SLOT_NOT_OFFERED, SLOT_NOT_BOOKABLE, DUPLICATE_BOOKING, SERVICE_NOT_BOOKABLE, DELIVERY_MODE_REQUIRED, INVALID_STARTS_AT.

get.description: The customer's own booking, or any booking of the Enterprise Admin's enterprise (a Provider: their own). Anyone else gets 404. Times are ISO-8601 with the service's UTC offset; `timezone` is the IANA name. `meeting.url` appears for a customer from `meeting.joins_at` until shortly after the end; staff always see it.

post.summary: Cancel a booking, or ask to
post.description: Customer: inside the free window (or while the booking is still pending) the booking is cancelled at once and capacity is released; later it becomes `cancellation_requested` (a `reason` of at least 3 characters is needed) for the Enterprise Admin to decide, or 409 `CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED` with the policy when the service does not allow requests. The booking detail's `can_cancel`, `cancel_mode` and `cancel_blocked_reason` say which applies. A paid booking records the refund (`refund_percent`, `refund_amount`, `payment_status`): no money moves yet. The Enterprise Admin cancelling uses the same call (reason required, default refund 100%).

patch.description: pending -> confirmed | cancelled; confirmed -> in_progress | completed | no_show | cancelled; in_progress -> completed. A paid service cannot be confirmed before the payment is recorded (409 PAYMENT_REQUIRED); in_progress opens 15 minutes before the start; completed and no_show only once it has started; cancelled needs a reason. A Provider can only start, complete or mark no-show their own bookings. A booking with a cancellation request is decided with approve / reject. 409 INVALID_TRANSITION lists the `allowed` statuses.

post.description: Cancels the booking, releases the slot and records the refund: the service's `refund_percent_after` unless `refund_percent` is sent.
The booking goes back to the status it had; a `reason` (at least 3 characters) is required and the customer is told.

post.summary: Record that a booking was paid (Enterprise Admin)
post.description: Sets `payment_status` to `paid` (status only: no payment gateway is involved). A pending booking is confirmed unless the service requires approval. 409 HOLD_EXPIRED if the unpaid hold already ran out.

A stand-in until a payment gateway is connected: marks the customer's own unpaid booking paid. Available only where SERVICE_BOOKING_DEMO_PAYMENT is on (off in production by default: 403 PAYMENT_NOT_AVAILABLE).

get.description: Every change in order: who (role; staff also see the name), what, from which status to which, why, and when.

schema.title: Response Booking History Api V1 Service Bookings  Booking Id  History Get

get.description: The caller's own bookings only. `when=upcoming` (soonest first, still active), `past` (newest first, started or finished) or all (newest first); `status` is one or several comma separated statuses.

get.summary: Cancellation requests waiting for a decision
get.description: Oldest request first. Enterprise Admin of the enterprise (a Provider: their own bookings; Super Admin: any).

Enterprise Admin of the enterprise (a Provider sees only their own; Super Admin any). Filters: `status` (comma separated), `service_id`, `provider_id`, `payment_status`, `q` (customer name or e-mail, service, provider), `date_from` / `date_to` (the start, calendar dates in UTC), `when` = upcoming | past | all (history). Another enterprise's id is a 404.

starts_at.title: Starts At
starts_at.description: ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (or Z), exactly the `starts_at` of a slot from available-slots. A time without an offset is a 422.

delivery_mode.title: Delivery Mode
delivery_mode.description: Required when the service offers more than one way to attend.

provider_id.title: Provider Id
provider_id.description: Optional. Must be the service's provider.

paid.title: Paid
paid.description: Staff only: the customer already paid, so the booking is confirmed straight away.

starts_at.title: Starts At
starts_at.description: ISO-8601 with the service's UTC offset.

cancel_mode.title: Cancel Mode
cancel_mode.description: What cancelling does now: cancel at once, or send a request the clinic decides.

can_reschedule.title: Can Reschedule
can_reschedule.description: Always false in this release (rescheduling is a later phase).

can_check_in.title: Can Check In
can_check_in.description: Always false in this release: the clinic marks attendance.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: in_person and hybrid: name, line1, line2, city, state, postal_code, country, lat, lng, phone, instructions.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: virtual and hybrid: provider, joins_at, available, and url / passcode / instructions once the link opens (staff always).

hold_expires_at.title: Hold Expires At
hold_expires_at.description: An unpaid booking holds its slot until then.

payment_id.title: Payment Id
payment_id.description: Always null: payment is a status on the booking for now.

allowed_statuses.title: Allowed Statuses
allowed_statuses.description: Staff only: the statuses this booking can be moved to.

starts_at.title: Starts At
starts_at.description: ISO-8601 with the service's UTC offset.

cancel_mode.title: Cancel Mode
cancel_mode.description: What cancelling does now: cancel at once, or send a request the clinic decides.

can_reschedule.description: Always false in this release (rescheduling is a later phase).

can_check_in.title: Can Check In
can_check_in.description: Always false in this release: the clinic marks attendance.

BookingSettings.title: BookingSettings
BookingSettings.description: Staff only: everything the booking needs from the service, including the meeting link.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional for an instant cancellation; at least 3 characters when the cancellation is a request.

refund_percent.title: Refund Percent
refund_percent.description: Staff only: how much of a paid booking is refunded (default 100).

free_cancellation_hours.title: Free Cancellation Hours
free_cancellation_hours.description: A customer can cancel on their own up to this many hours before the start.

refund_percent_before.title: Refund Percent Before
refund_percent_before.description: Share refunded when cancelled inside the free window.

refund_percent_after.title: Refund Percent After
refund_percent_after.description: Share refunded when an admin approves a cancellation requested after the window.

allow_request_after_window.title: Allow Request After Window
allow_request_after_window.description: After the window a customer can still ask (an admin decides); false = not allowed.

CancellationRules.title: CancellationRules
CancellationRules.description: The structured cancellation policy a booking follows (the free-text `cancellation_policy` stays as the wording shown to people).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Required to reject; optional note when approving.

refund_percent.title: Refund Percent
refund_percent.description: When approving: overrides the service's refund_percent_after.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: A receipt or transaction note, kept in the history.

starts_at.title: Starts At
starts_at.description: Send this exact value as `starts_at` when booking.

starts_at_display.title: Starts At Display
starts_at_display.description: The same instant in the `timezone` you asked for.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the service cannot be booked at all, when `bookable` is false.

refund_percent.title: Refund Percent
refund_percent.description: With `cancelled`: how much of a paid booking is refunded (default 100).

BearerAuth.description:
JWT **access token** for authenticated API requests.

## Primary — Invigorate Auth (Production)

1. Login: `POST https://admin.apis.invigor8.app/api/v1/auth/login`
2. Copy: `tokens.access_token` from the response
3. Click **Authorize** above and paste the token (Swagger adds `Bearer ` automatically)
4. Call any protected endpoint on this marketplace API

| Setting | Value |
|---------|-------|
| Algorithm | RS256 |
| Issuer (`iss`) | `https://auth.invigor8.app/realms/invigorate-healthcare` |
| Audience (`aud`) | `invigorate-api` **or** `azp=invigorate-api` |
| JWKS | `https://auth.invigor8.app/realms/invigorate-healthcare/protocol/openid-connect/certs` |
| User ID claim | `sub` (Keycloak user ID) |
| App User UUID | `GET /api/v1/auth/me` on auth API (different from `sub`) |

**Role claims:** `isSuperAdmin` (Platform Super Admin login → `super_admin`), `tenant_role`, `user_role`, `tenant_rbac_roles`, `tenant_permissions`

See **Authentication** → `GET /api/v1/auth/integration` for full reference.

**Dual auth (same routes, no duplicate APIs):**
- **Enterprise Admin portal** — HttpOnly cookie `access_token` (`credentials: include`)
- **Platform Super Admin portal** — `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` from dedicated Super Admin login

Both use the same JWT validation path (`get_current_user`). Public catalog GETs (products, services) remain unauthenticated.

## Fallback — Local dev token (Testing only)

`GET /api/v1/auth/dev-token` when `ENABLE_DEV_TOKEN=true` — local HS256 token, not Invigorate auth.
